Power Station
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be performed 
on an annually bases
as indicated by Y1 in the title block,
The vibration 
sensor
39V 1,2,3. Dwg no. 158A7476 P008, Mfg: VITEC, USA,
 Vitec P/N: 602885-49T
The first draft initiated by eng. Taher 
Abdel Galel, tested by eng. Tarek El Sayed Abdel Razeq at 02 June 
2002, reviewed by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abd El-Momem El-Emam, 
accepted by general director eng. Yousry Abd El-Maksuod, and approved by eng. 
Mostafa Allam head sector of Talkha PS
Safety Precautions
Unit must be shutdown
Work order must be issued
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc
Tools and Equipment
Digital voltmeter
Suitable tool set
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the external serves
Check the cable of the sensor for tightness
Check the output impedance IMP (Z) value
 < 500 ohms at temp (0 F to 400 F)
Check the output voltage 200 mV at 1" / sec
Repeat the steps from 1 to 4 for 39V2, 39V3
